questionSnapshot.question: In 101 Dalmatians, how many puppies do Pongo and Perdita originally have?

notes: Read all four answers and relevant full topic digests/category context; checked cross-bank matches, wording, scope, category and editorial difficulty. Separated biological first litter from rescued/adopted puppies and total dogs. Film entry expressly gives 15, 99 and 101 in different roles; Perdita’s separate entry corroborates 15. 50 fits none. Original litter is not a claim that the couple never adopts more.
